from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetric(BaseModel):
    """Extracted data from a single university's CDS report relevant to recruitment efficiency."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    enrollment_first_year: int | None = Field(description="Total enrolled first-time, first-year degree-seeking students (Section C1)")
    total_faculty: int | None = Field(description="Total instructional faculty members (Section I-1)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityMetric]
